prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results across most tests.
Evidence is still thin for finish new_flow, choose_path copy, home notification, sign_in hint, sign_in layout, and sign_in notification because each has only 1 test.
No clear effect was seen for choose_path reorder changes across 2 tests.
Adoption redesign changes consistently reduced performance across 2 tests after noise correction.
Home wait_info changes showed mixed results across 2 tests, with one win (+4.2%) and one test showing no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -3.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- choose_path, copy: -5.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, reorder: +1.8% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_flow: +9.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, notification: -0.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, layout: +1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, notification: +1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 86.8%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 78.6%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Controls Walkthrough Screen: Add a dedicated new post-intro screen demonstrating how to interact, minimize, move, and summon the pet from the system tray. (why: Multiple support tickets report confusion over how to control, hide, or talk to the pet once setup concludes.)
1: [home, wait_info] Animated Companion Teaser During Setup Wait: Display an animated desktop preview companion on the waiting screen while pet assets build. (why: The waiting step has a high mean duration (2336s) and median duration (201s), causing dropoff during setup.)
2: [choose_path, new_flow] Path Overview Choice Explainer Screen: Insert a new introductory path overview screen before path selection that clearly contrasts ready-made adoption versus custom photo generation. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path, taking up to 514s mean time due to uncertainty about what each path entails.)
3: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Selection Mascot Guidance: Add a clear mascot tip hint on the photo upload screen recommending well-lit single-subject photos. (why: Support received multiple reports of custom pet creation failures or poor rendering quality.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Sign-In Verification Desktop Alert: Enable ready notifications on the sign-in screen and display account restore guidance. (why: 72.9% conversion on sign_in with high mean time (567s) and frequent missing account issues upon relogin.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Instant Desktop Companion Value Copy: Rewrite choose_path screen copy to highlight quick setup times and immediate companion availability. (why: Users take an average of 514s on choose_path, showing decision friction.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Instant Availability Adoption Badge: Add an explicit instant adoption readiness badge on the pick_friend screen. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a mean duration of 1017s.)
7: [home, layout] Split Readiness View for Setup Waiting: Switch the waiting screen to a split layout separating live setup progress from background companion preparation. (why: Home waiting screen has the largest mean duration in the funnel (2336s).)

scores.note: Addressed support tickets and dropoff at finish, but adding a new screen carries dev cost.
Wait info changes have proven effective (+2.1% avg), targeting long setup wait times.
Targeting 23.8% dropoff on choose_path with a new screen, but extra screens add friction.
Adoption has the highest dropoff (39.1%) and strong support feedback; hints are cheap to implement.
Addresses sign_in dropoff and account restore support tickets; notifications showed mild past lift (+1.3%).
Low cost, but choose_path copy changes performed poorly (-5.3%) in prior testing.
Targets highest dropoff step (adoption), though full redesigns hurt metrics previously.
Addresses long home wait duration, but layout changes require significant engineering effort.
